## Summary

- hard-cut the release workflow into `prepare-exact-sha`, `certify-exact-sha`, and `publish-certified-bytes`
- add separate STOP-only certification, evidence-ingress, Apple, readiness, and final-public verification workflows
- bind candidate/readiness adoption to exact GitHub coordinates, canonical digests, frozen Node/npm behavior, offline trust, and exact-byte publication
- add the package-private Apple Notary boundary and exact 28-coordinate receipt protocol
- document the remaining external npm, Apple, journal, and GitHub governance gates
- make the readiness verification suite portable across the hosted Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows runners without weakening the POSIX-only protected publisher boundary

## Verification

- [x] exact branch-head push CI passes 33/33 at `1b2ee64b2ce02cc7e816e40a3f44339d0b7fedc1`
- [ ] PR CI passes 33/33 at the same head
- [x] pinned Bun 1.3.14 full verification passes
- [x] all 40 generated protected-body coordinates pass on the Ubuntu-compatible Bash boundary
- [x] Apple coordinates remain exactly N=2, P=10, G=6, A=10
- [x] `git diff --check` passes

Push evidence: https://github.com/mannyc2/effect-build/actions/runs/33464396338

## Release boundary

This is the inert infrastructure merge described by Plan 045. Merging it does not itself establish release point R or publish npm packages, submit Apple artifacts, create a tag, or publish a GitHub Release. Rolldown remains reservation-only. Protected modes remain fail-closed until their external authorities and evidence are qualified.

## Summary

- bind npm and Apple release authority to the live immutable repository-ID OIDC subject
- update the fail-closed authority audit and rejection fixtures
- refresh the generated canonical contract and Plan 045 current-state record

## Verification

- pinned Bun 1.3.14 `bun run verify`
- 13 contract tests, 160 unit tests, 46 Apple tests, 282 architecture tests
- 79/79 exact protected publisher state-machine cases

## Scope

This PR activates only the observed immutable-subject contract. It does not dispatch credentials, publish npm packages, create tags or releases, or claim that the remaining external evidence and Apple gates are complete.

pullRequests.body:
The final 0.6.2 verification failed after all eleven npm packages and the immutable GitHub Release were published. Its Bun registry consumer passed `--config` and the config path as separate arguments; pinned Bun 1.3.14 treated that path as an install dependency and failed with `ENOTDIR`.

Pass the documented single `--config=<path>` argument. The new regression extracts and executes the complete production install argument array with the real pinned Bun CLI against an empty isolated package, covering parser behavior directly. Existing credential, configuration, fresh-cache, module, pipeline, provenance, and artifact checks remain required.

Corrected Node 24.14.1/npm 11.11.0 and Bun 1.3.14 consumers passed all 42 modules and three pipelines against the published 0.6.2 packages. The complete modified-harness diagnostic collector also passed with actual GitHub/npm reads, every package and asset, cryptographic provenance, both consumers, readiness, and final main re-observation. This is diagnostic evidence, not a substitute for hosted certification.

The new registry baseline also distinguishes historical reservation evidence from current public versions. The namespace collector reads placeholder bytes from their recorded version. Both shared and protected readiness validators permit retained public history, while only reserved-only packages require a singleton version history. The protected publisher continues to enforce the full authenticated readiness snapshot plus the canonical publication prefix before every mutation. Public package identity, exact tags, absent target/newer versions, and immutable placeholder digests remain enforced. The simulated registry and its semantic readiness evidence seed every tagged public version instead of pointing `latest` at a missing version. Regression coverage compares those snapshots and rejects missing historical placeholder bytes.

Certification is bound to the release source commit, so the target advances to 0.6.3 with all eleven prior-latest entries set to the observed 0.6.2 state. Existing 0.6.2 packages, tag, and immutable release remain intact. Library implementations and the public API are unchanged; Rolldown remains reserved and credential-backed Apple artifact certification remains deferred.

Validation: focused credential-free consumer tests 6/6, readiness tests 9/9, and a real fake-baseline regression passed. Corrected live consumers, the complete local collector, and the actual live namespace collection/validation (eleven public packages and seven retained placeholders) passed. Type checks, all 167 architecture tests, the complete 81-case publisher suite, lint, and formatting passed. Independent final scope review confirmed unchanged public API/library source, all eight fixture hashes, and unchanged workflow permissions and credential boundaries. Pinned Bun 1.3.14 full `bun run verify` passed, including all 81 publisher tests; `pnpm verify` rejects this workspace's Bun package-manager declaration. Fresh exact-main certification and publication will follow the merge.
